summaryBox.title: 10 NEST Traps
summaryBox.takeaway: Kharasch strictly for HBr; Halogens are o/p deactivating; FC alkylation rearranges 1-chloropropane to cumene; COT is non-aromatic tub; Only terminal alkynes react with Tollens'.

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
10 NEST TRAPS SUMMARY

1. Kharasch peroxide effect applies STRICTLY to HBr (fails for HCl/HI).
2. Halogens on benzene are Deactivating BUT Ortho/Para-Directing.
3. FC alkylation of benzene with 1-chloropropane yields Isopropylbenzene (Cumene) via 1,2-hydride shift.
4. Cyclooctatetraene (COT, 8π e⁻) is non-planar tub-shaped and NON-AROMATIC.
5. ONLY terminal alkynes (R-C≡C-H) give white ppt with Tollens' reagent.
6. Staggered ethane is 12.5 kJ/mol more stable than eclipsed.
7. Reductive ozonolysis (Zn/H₂O) yields aldehydes/ketones; Oxidative (H₂O₂) yields acids.
8. Hydroboration-oxidation (HBO) gives Anti-Markovnikov, Syn-addition of water.
9. Benzene undergoes S_EAr (substitution) to preserve 150.6 kJ/mol resonance energy.
10. Bromination of alkanes is highly selective for 3° hydrogens (1600:1).
